meta: Part 3 of "AI and your job". As AI does more and more, which skills keep you valuable? This video names four: judgment, fact-checking, connecting with people, and being AI's boss.

muc.title: The work that still needs you
muc.text: Last time, we found the parts of your work that still need you. Now let's name the skills inside them.

muc.title: Judgment
muc.text: First is judgment. AI gives you ten options, but which one to pick, and when, is still up to you.

muc.title: Fact-checking
muc.text: Second is fact-checking. AI can make things up, as we know. People who can spot the mistakes will always be valuable.

muc.title: Connecting with people
muc.text: Third is working with people: listening, persuading, comforting and leading a team. Customers still want to talk to a person.

muc.title: Being AI's boss
muc.text: And a new skill: being AI's boss. Give clear tasks, check the results, ask for fixes, and only then use them.

muc.title: Grade AI's work with 3 questions
muc.text: Give AI a real task from your week. Then grade its work with three questions: is it right, is it complete, does it fit the person receiving it?

muc.title: Show it to employers
muc.text: You have the skills. How do you show them to employers? Part four shows how.
